name: Synthacon
tagline: Buy, sell, and rent studio and music gear
voice: A musician talking to another musician, never a brand talking at a customer. Plain, informed, peer-to-peer; the simplest word that carries the meaning; earn every adjective. Marketplace + community to buy, sell, and rent studio and music gear, in open beta; the rent/lend angle is the story. CTA: Join the beta. HARD rules: no marketing-speak category labels, no fake or invented metrics (prefer no numbers at all during beta), no em-dashes in any public copy, no unshipped features. Color rules: violet #a090dc is rich, never neon; heroes sit on a dark gradient, never a bright violet wash; gold #e6b53d is the events/promo accent only; green #4ade80 means success/online only; red #f06870 means error only; steel-blue #6898b8 is info, never pink. Prices and data render in JetBrains Mono.
